using System;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Duplicati.Library.Tests
{
    public class OAuthHttpClientTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task SendAsync_WithAuthentication_RequestIsAuthenticated()
        {
            // Arrange
            var handlerMock = new Mock<HttpMessageHandler>();
            var httpClient = new OAuthHttpClient(handlerMock.Object);
            var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Get, "https://example.com");

            // Act
            await httpClient.SendAsync(request, true, CancellationToken.None);

            // Assert
            handlerMock.Protected().Verify(
                "SendAsync",
                Times.Exactly(1),
                ItExpr.Is<HttpRequestMessage>(req => req == request),
                ItExpr.IsAny<CancellationToken>());
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task SendAsync_WithoutAuthentication_RequestIsNotAuthenticated()
        {
            // Arrange
            var handlerMock = new Mock<HttpMessageHandler>();
            var httpClient = new OAuthHttpClient(handlerMock.Object);
            var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Get, "https://example.com");

            // Act
            await httpClient.SendAsync(request, false, CancellationToken.None);

            // Assert
            handlerMock.Protected().Verify(
                "SendAsync",
                Times.Exactly(1),
                ItExpr.Is<HttpRequestMessage>(req => req == request),
                ItExpr.IsAny<CancellationToken>());
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task SendAsync_WithTimeout_ThrowsTimeoutException()
        {
            // Arrange
            var handlerMock = new Mock<HttpMessageHandler>();
            handlerMock
                .Protected()
                .Setup<Task<HttpResponseMessage>>(
                    "SendAsync",
                    ItExpr.IsAny<HttpRequestMessage>(),
                    ItExpr.IsAny<CancellationToken>()
                )
                .Throws(new OperationCanceledException());
            var httpClient = new OAuthHttpClient(handlerMock.Object);
            var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Get, "https://example.com");

            // Act and Assert
            await Assert.ThrowsAsync<TimeoutException>(() => httpClient.SendAsync(request, true, CancellationToken.None));
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Duplicati.Library
{
    public class OAuthHttpMessageHandler : DelegatingHandler
    {
        private readonly string m_authid;
        private readonly string m_protocolKey;
        private readonly string m_oauthurl;

        public OAuthHttpMessageHandler(string authid, string protocolKey, string oauthurl)
        {
            this.m_authid = authid;
            this.m_protocolKey = protocolKey;
            this.m_oauthurl = oauthurl;
        }

        protected override async Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(HttpRequestMessage request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            // Authenticate the request
            var authenticatedRequest = await this.AuthenticateRequestAsync(request, cancellationToken);

            // Send the authenticated request
            return await base.SendAsync(authenticatedRequest, cancellationToken);
        }

        private async Task<HttpRequestMessage> AuthenticateRequestAsync(HttpRequestMessage request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            // Authenticate the request using OAuth
            var authenticationResult = await this.GetAuthenticationResultAsync(cancellationToken);

            // Add the authentication token to the request
            request.Headers.Authorization = new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", authenticationResult.AccessToken);

            return request;
        }

        private async Task<AuthenticationResult> GetAuthenticationResultAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            // Get the authentication result using OAuth
            var authenticationResult = await this.GetAccessTokenAsync(cancellationToken);

            return authenticationResult;
        }

        private async Task<AuthenticationResult> GetAccessTokenAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            // Get the access token using OAuth
            var accessToken = await this.GetAccessTokenFromCacheAsync(cancellationToken);

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(accessToken))
            {
                // Get the access token from the OAuth server
                accessToken = await this.GetAccessTokenFromServerAsync(cancellationToken);
            }

            return new AuthenticationResult(accessToken);
        }

        private async Task<string> GetAccessTokenFromCacheAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            // Get the access token from the cache
            var cache = new OAuthCache();
            var accessToken = await cache.GetAccessTokenAsync(this.m_authid, this.m_protocolKey, cancellationToken);

            return accessToken;
        }

        private async Task<string> GetAccessTokenFromServerAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            // Get the access token from the OAuth server
            var httpClient = new HttpClient();
            var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, this.m_oauthurl);
            var response = await httpClient.SendAsync(request, cancellationToken);

            // Parse the response
            var responseBody = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
            var accessToken = OAuthHelper.ParseAccessToken(responseBody);

            return accessToken;
        }
    }

    public class AuthenticationResult
    {
        public string AccessToken { get; set; }

        public AuthenticationResult(string accessToken)
        {
            this.AccessToken = accessToken;
        }
    }
}
